First build succeeded and produced RepoPact Workbench_0.1.0_amd64.deb, but inspection (dpkg-deb --contents) showed NO icon assets were bundled at all -- tauri.conf.json's bundle.icon only listed icons/icon.ico, which Linux/deb bundlers cannot derive a hicolor icon-theme PNG set from.

commands.command: fix: tauri.conf.json bundle.icon now lists 32x32.png, 128x128.png, 128x128@2x.png, icon.icns, icon.ico
commands.summary: Corrected the shared bundle icon list (affects Windows/Linux/macOS bundlers alike) and rebuilt.
Rebuilt with the icon fix. dpkg-deb --contents now shows usr/share/icons/hicolor/{32x32,128x128,256x256@2}/apps/repopact-desktop.png alongside the executable and .desktop file.

Identical hash (397ab6cf...fbb437) -- the installed Linux launcher icon is byte-for-byte the same RP mark used on Windows and Android, not a stale placeholder.

desktop_file.Name: RepoPact Workbench
desktop_file.verdict: Exec resolves via PATH to the package-installed /usr/bin/repopact-desktop, not a dev/build-tree path; Icon resolves via the hicolor icon theme to the package-installed RP mark; no C:/mnt/c or ~/repopact-wi062 path embedded anywhere.

defect_found_and_fixed.symptom: The first .deb build's Linux bundle contained the executable and .desktop file but zero icon assets; the .desktop's Icon=repopact-desktop reference would have resolved to nothing on a real system with no other icon-theme fallback.
defect_found_and_fixed.root_cause: tauri.conf.json's shared bundle.icon array listed only icons/icon.ico (a Windows-only format); Tauri's deb/AppImage bundlers need PNG sources to populate /usr/share/icons/hicolor/<size>/apps/.
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: Added icons/32x32.png, icons/128x128.png, icons/128x128@2x.png, and icons/icon.icns to bundle.icon alongside icons/icon.ico, matching Tauri's own default project template shape. This is a shared config file affecting all bundlers, not a Linux-only patch.
defect_found_and_fixed.verified: Rebuilt .deb inspected before install and confirmed hicolor icon PNGs present at all three sizes with content matching the canonical RP source hash.

residuals: The repository-picker dialog (rfd/xdg-desktop-portal-gtk) did not visibly appear when 'Choose repository' was clicked under WSLg/RAIL, despite xdg-desktop-portal and xdg-desktop-portal-gtk both being installed and running. Not investigated further within WI062's time-box since native repository selection is explicitly optional in the directive ('if usable'); worth a follow-up look if Linux desktop usage becomes a priority.

The RAIL window's own close button did not visibly close the app on the first attempt; the app was instead closed via process termination for that step of the smoke test. Not investigated further; may be a WSLg/RAIL window-decoration quirk rather than an application defect, since the second launch/close cycle was not re-tested against the close button specifically.

Window resize was not tested via interactive drag (computer-use's desktop-shell click guard blocked dragging the window border); the maximize button click also produced no visible size change. The window was, however, observed to render correctly at two different sizes across the two launches, which is suggestive but not a substitute for an explicit resize test.
Jeremy has not yet personally confirmed the WSLg window with his own eyes; the app was left running (post-reinstall) specifically so he can look at it.
